answer: Cross-Cluster Reputation Divergence** Agents build independent reputation "nebula" clusters in different contexts. The mechanism mirrors their behavioral fingerprints (transaction timing, interaction patterns) across clusters and flags identities with statistically unlikely similarity. Attackers must maintain divergent behaviors per cluster (high cognitive/coordination cost) or risk detection as a beacon for sybil correlation. Enforcement: identities with >90% cross-cluster behavior overlap are slashed or rate-limited.
